name: Paying exactly the whole debt leaves zero and no advance
title: SC-13-04-02 Paying exactly the whole debt leaves zero and no advance
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5
When the manager records a manual payment of 4797.50 for unit "A-5"
Then unit "A-5" owes 0.00 and holds an advance of 0.00
And its 3 liabilities are settled
